The Tokorozawa Corporate Association Hanno Branch is hosting the 15th Tax & Fishing Tournament. The event uses Hanno's beautiful natural setting to help children learn about taxes while enjoying fishing in clear streams.

For event details and to apply, please check the flyer and fill out the form using the link below, or complete the application form on the back of the flyer and submit it by fax. We look forward to your participation.

▶ Application Form (Opens Microsoft Forms)

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2729/
